title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Credit Office Rate Table: Down-Payment Rate After Plans That Ended Early
content:
## Credit office rate table: plan history

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the down-payment rate starts from the account's plan history: 35 percent when two or more payment-plan requests on the account are recorded as cancelled (the record of a plan that ended early because an installment was missed) and were requested less than 24 whole months before the handling date, and 25 percent when exactly one such request is. When no such request is, plan history sets no starting rate of its own.

The requests read are the account's service requests of the payment-plan type whose status is cancelled, dated by their request date.

### Starting rate by plan history

| Payment-plan requests recorded as cancelled, requested less than 24 whole months before the handling date | Down-payment rate starts at |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 35 percent |
| exactly 1 | 25 percent |
| none | no plan-history rate |

### Hypothetical histories

- One plan cancelled 10 months ago and another 20 months ago: two in the span, 35 percent.
- One plan cancelled 10 months ago and another 30 months ago: only one in the span, 25 percent.
- One plan cancelled exactly 24 whole months before the handling date: outside the span (it must be less than 24 whole months), no plan-history rate.
- Plans recorded as completed are not cancelled plans and do not count here.
